versions.changelog:
- Initial release of optimal-order-routing skill.
- Provides real-time exchange and order type recommendations for minimum cost crypto execution across Kraken, Coinbase Advanced Trade, and Hyperliquid.
- Requires only an EVM wallet with USDC on Base mainnet; no API keys or subscriptions needed.
- Features tiered, usage-based pricing with automatic early adopter discounts.
- Integrates with related trading signals for advanced execution strategies.
